release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.26 reworks Tasks into a cleaner five-module workspace: Pokemon Center, Target, Walmart, Amazon, and Cookie Generator / Shape. Retailer task creation keeps its existing fields, resource bindings, advanced options, task list, templates, filters, bulk actions and diagnostics, but oversized decorative retailer hero surfaces are removed, spacing is tightened, task rows are simplified, and the full Fleet Manager is preserved behind a compact Manage Fleet disclosure so advanced controls are available without dominating the page. The fifth module is implemented as a bounded standard browser-session generator: Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox support headed or headless launches when installed; Safari is exposed consistently but is available only on macOS and headed-only. Each supported non-Safari launch receives an isolated temporary browser profile and an optional http/https start URL, with recent-session status and stop controls. The module deliberately does not expose remote-debugging ports, browser cookie-database extraction, challenge-token export, or anti-bot bypass/forging behavior. The Member-versus-Owner binary boundary and private Owner Stable updater remain unchanged. PR #338 passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight including composed UI/DOM, Go/source hygiene, race and vulnerability gates, Owner Windows Consumer E2E with the real Wails/WebView2 shell, Member Build Boundary with the exact compiled member candidate and owner-module exclusion, and both Go and JavaScript/TypeScript CodeQL high-severity gates before merge.
